title: The Spotlight profile button shows the owner's label, not the web address

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): the top button on his Spotlight should say 'Launch your biz in 12 minutes', 'not frequencylocal.com'.

detail: On the New World profile look the main button printed the link's host (frequencylocal.com) and ignored the label the owner typed in the Links block, so renaming a link in the editor changed nothing on the page. It now reads the label, falling back to the host only for an unlabelled link.

verify.note: Fails while the profile button labels itself with the host.
